column1: 5. Column names: these could contain the minimal information so we can avoid having a very large header with measurement point information.

1. Separator is an underscore however element names also use underscore. This can cause a problem with splitting out the data into individual components. Can use a different separator such as a colon (:) or semicolon (;) similar to Ammonit loggers?
Can't use a hyphen (-) as it can get mixed up with a negative height and dimensionless units.
Can't use a period (.) as it can get mixed up with decimal heights and/or lat and long.
Semicolon can also be used as a delimiter so we should avoid that however if the delimiter is a comma we could use a semicolon.
Or we can just handle the underscores?
